text_en: You're that soldier from that cave, right? Thank the Gods you arrived! Thank you, I'm heading back to the others.
Thank you so much, you show great bravery going it alone in here. I'm off, I need to find the Captain.
I hate the desert... I knew we shouldn't have come here. We're lucky you found us.
I couldn't bear being trapped inside any longer. I'll follow the instructions and head to the meeting point.
Thank you, friend! The Captain's looking for us as well, right? I'd better catch up with the others.
